note: Task cases. 'says' with text must be in the grounded page; cross-module cases name evidence the gate or tools/check_evidence.py checks.

cases.prompt: I have 40 stills, one per shot, with their old motion lines in a spreadsheet. Where do I start?

assertions.what: a shots table with shot, scene, still and motion columns, the stills at public addresses
scenes are cut by continuous place and time, numbered Scene_NNN
to generate anything

cases.prompt: Shots 2, 3 and 4 are all in the ferry cabin, in one continuous moment. Shot 3 is an insert of her hands and 4 is a close-up of the boy. How many cabin plates?

assertions.what: one plate for the scene's one camera side, used by the close-ups too
the plate sits under Scene_002, in both the Seedream and GPT Image folders
one plate per still

cases.prompt: Marta is in scenes 2 and 3 in the same coat. Where do her files go?

assertions.what: a scene folder per scene holding only that scene's state, pointing at the canon
no scene prompt when nothing differs from the canon

cases.prompt: The baker is kneading dough; behind him there's a candlestick, bowls and a lantern. Which props get prompts?

assertions.what: the dough, because he handles it; the baker himself
the candlestick, bowls and lantern are background, listed but not made
a prompt for the candlestick

cases.prompt: Dock workers appear in shots 1 and 10, which are different scenes. One extras sheet?

assertions.what: no: one sheet per scene, only the people seen together in it
each person carries the nationality of the scene's country
GPT Image with the scene's still as costume reference; not Seedream

evidence.needle: Every person carries the nationality of the scene's country

cases.prompt: Scene 2 has three shots. Where does its video prompt go and what is it called?

assertions.what: one generation for the scene beat, its shots with hard cuts and the scene's locks at the top
coverage.py links that file to every shot in its range

evidence.needle: Video prompts are PROMPTS/VIDEO/Scene_NNN/SHOT_NNN.md or SHOTS_NNN-NNN.md.

cases.prompt: Can I keep the shot notes next to the prompt files so I see both?

assertions.what: no: every .md in a generator's input folder is a job; notes live in MAP/

evidence.needle: Every `.md` in a generator's input folder, subfolders included, is a job.

cases.prompt: I just wrote props for scenes 1 to 5. What now?

assertions.what: scripts/check_prompts.py and scripts/coverage.py, or says to run them
what is missing first, then what was decided, then the counts
a list of open questions for every disagreement

cases.prompt: Which model for the plates, the props and the extras?

assertions.what: plates in both Seedream and GPT Image, then pick
props and vehicles in Seedream
extras in GPT Image with the still as costume reference; not Seedream

assertions.text: Soul did horribly on environments and props

cases.prompt: Shot 1 is a wide of a city street at night: a man walks away, cars parked and driving. Write the environment plate prompt.

assertions.text: This is a simple editing job to remove all the people

assertions.what: keep the traffic
a re-description of the street block by block, a film-look block or a negative list

evidence.needle: This is a simple editing job to remove all the people

cases.prompt: Write the prop prompt for the axe the woodcutter swings in shot 2.

assertions.text: Keep its exact shape, material and wear

assertions.what: take the axe from the attached still and show it on its own in natural overcast daylight
an itemised construction, a look block or a negative list

evidence.needle: Keep its exact shape, material and wear
